description: Implementation of ProductAttributeDao for accessing product attribute data using JPA queries within a Spring repository context.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductAttribute, providing methods to retrieve product attribute data from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute by its ID, fetching related product, option, option value, descriptions, and merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific product option ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes matching a list of attribute IDs for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific option value ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes for a given product, store, and language, including related option values and descriptions.
